title: Remote viewing used to trade silver futures

tellings.quote: can go back and the next day on the average you get get your money we ran 70 30 instead of 50 50.

plain: A physicist named Hal Puthoff, known for studying the paranormal for the CIA, says remote viewing (trying to sense distant or future things with the mind alone) was used to bet on silver futures, which are wagers on whether the price of silver will go up or down. He says that on average they were right 70 percent of the time instead of the 50 percent chance would give, and could collect the money the next day. He tells it from his own experience, in a debate with Michels and Eric Weinstein, as evidence that the ability works in a way you can measure.
